**Coaching note (club player, max 80 words):**

White's rook on d1 is undefended—the threats list showed it's attacked by your queen but has no defender. More importantly, when you capture it, you give check simultaneously. Your opponent cannot recapture immediately because the king is in check and must move first. This wins the rook cleanly. Always look for checks when capturing loose pieces: they often prevent your opponent from recapturing on the same move. This is a devastating combination here.
